name: rico
description: Rich comments: review rendered markdown in GitHub PRs, with comments that span paragraphs

scripts.test: node --test --test-timeout=30000 test/lib.test.js test/server.test.js test/worker.test.js test/comments.test.js test/frame.test.js test/icon.test.js test/anchor.test.js test/spec.test.js test/seed.test.js
scripts.deploy:stage: npm run build && wrangler deploy --env stage
scripts.e2e: node e2e/run.mjs && node e2e/commit.mjs && node e2e/spec.mjs
scripts.deploy:embed: npm run build && node scripts/build-embed.mjs && wrangler deploy -c wrangler.embed.toml
scripts.deploy:stage:embed: npm run build && node scripts/build-embed.mjs && wrangler deploy -c wrangler.embed.toml --env stage
